sudo install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec /var/www/fleet
printf '%s\n' 'Fleet HTTPS service on node2' | sudo tee /var/www/fleet/index.html >/dev/null
sudo tee /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server.py >/dev/null <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import functools
import http.server
import ssl

handler = functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory="/var/www/fleet")
server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), handler)
context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
context.load_cert_chain("/etc/pki/node2/server.crt", "/etc/pki/node2/server.key")
server.socket = context.wrap_socket(server.socket, server_side=True)
server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server.py
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service >/dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Fleet internal HTTPS service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
User=root
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=strict

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
